'''''Vicia narbonensis''''', called '''Narbon bean''', '''Narbon vetch''', '''Narbonne vetch''' and '''moor's pea''', is a widely distributed species of flowering plant in the family [[Fabaceae]]. It is native to Madeira and the Mediterranean countries through to Central Asia and the western Himalayas, and has been introduced to central and eastern Europe, and scattered other locations.<ref name="524974-1" >{{cite web |url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:524974-1 |title=''Vicia narbonensis'' L. |author=<!--Not stated--> |website=Plants of the World Online |publisher=Board of Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew |access-date=21 May 2021 }}</ref><ref name="Feedipedia240" >{{cite web |url=https://www.feedipedia.org/node/240 |title=Narbon vetch (''Vicia narbonensis'') |last1=Heuzé |first1=V. |last2=Tran |first2=G. |last3=Lebas |first3=F. |date=21 October 2015 |website=Feedipedia – Animal Feed Resources Information System |publisher=Feedipedia, a programme by INRAE, CIRAD, AFZ and FAO |access-date=21 May 2021 }}</ref> It has some palatability issues, but has potential as a green manure and forage crop, and for its beans.<ref name="Feedipedia240" /><ref name="1_of_3620_Google_Scholar_Hits" >{{cite journal |last1=Royo |first1=Marina Arias |last2=Tate |first2=Max |last3=Enneking |first3=Dirk |date=July 2006 |title=Narbon bean (''Vicia narbonensis'' L.) farmer's dream or devil's bean? |url=https://www.researchgate.net/publication/235351974 |journal=Grain Legumes |volume=47 |issue= |pages=18–19 |access-date=21 May 2021 }}</ref> It is the namesake of the ''Vicia narbonensis'' [[species complex]].<ref name="2_of_3620_Google_Scholar_Hits" >{{cite journal |title=Physical mapping of 18S-5.8S-26S and 5S ribosomal RNA gene families in three important vetches (''Vicia'' species) and their allied taxa constituting three species complexes |year=2001 |last1=Raina |first1=S. N. |last2=Mukai |first2=Y. |last3=Kawaguchi |first3=K. |last4=Goel |first4=S. |last5=Jain |first5=A. |journal=Theoretical and Applied Genetics |volume=103 |issue=6–7 |pages=839–845 |doi=10.1007/s001220100706 |s2cid=22800295 }}</ref>
